result.summary: The page appears visually intact overall, but the promotional banner has a significant readability issue.

issues.description: The white headline and offer details on the pale mint promotional banner have very low contrast, making the promotion code and minimum-order requirement difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Use dark green text or substantially darken the banner background. Ensure contrast meets WCAG AA: at least 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text.
